To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) young children are not aware of teleoperation, and that this lack of knowledge affects their interactions with a social robot; (2) young children's understanding of teleoperation is related to their trust in a social robot and to the quality of the interaction; and (3) children's knowledge of the teleoperator is related to their learning outcomes, and that this knowledge can be increased with a short training.
